A form is not done when the happy path works — it is done when the **unhappy
path** is covered too. A blocked account, a wrong password, a missing field:
each should produce a clear message, and each deserves a test that asserts it.

The RF Demo Shop has a `blocked_user` whose sign-in is refused with an error
banner. Assert that path.

## Task 1 — Assert the blocked-user error path

**Goal:** create `checks/forms.robot` that attempts a sign-in that must fail and
asserts the error banner.

Here is the same error-path shape for a different failure — a wrong password.
Adapt it to the blocked user.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Wrong Password Is Rejected
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    primary_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    wrong-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    Get Text    data-testid=login-error    contains    failed
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** the suite defines `Blocked User Sees An Error`.

<!-- hint -->
Sign in as `blocked_user` with the correct password `learning-password` — the
credentials are valid, but the account is blocked.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
The refusal shows in the error banner. Assert
`Get Text    data-testid=login-error    contains    blocked`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Blocked User Sees An Error
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    blocked_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    Get Text    data-testid=login-error    contains    blocked
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run it green

Run:

```bash
uv run robot checks
```

**Check:** the blocked-user test passes — the error banner is asserted.
